name: Trickplayer
description: Plex/Jellyfin player as synced thumbnails + subs

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Connects to Plex to sign in, and to your own Plex or Jellyfin server (plex.direct or tailscale ts.net) to download trick-play frames and subtitles.

notes: Pictures keep their shape. Films are shown at their own aspect ratio with black bars, rather than stretched to fill the frame — wide films are no longer squashed tall.
16:9 shows bigger. The picture area is now 256x144, so TV and other 16:9 material fills far more of it. Wide films look the same as before.
Faster when the link slows. The lower picture levels now cost about half what they did on busy scenes, so when the link struggles you get noticeably more pictures, not just smaller ones.

The picture steps down sooner, and less. When a full-quality frame is slow, the next level down — which keeps every horizontal pixel — takes over after a single slow frame, and full quality comes back as soon as the link allows.
A finer shading pattern at every level, with fewer blotchy frames in dark and smooth scenes.
Debugging tools: a new test measures what each picture actually costs the Bluetooth link.
